name: Camel Up
edition: Base game, rulebook copyright 2024 Lookout GmbH (second edition printing)

key_numbers.label: Dice out to end a leg

setup.text: Put the board in the middle. Make a stack of the 4 tickets of each colour (2, 2 at the bottom, then 3, then 5 on top) on its tent.
Stack the 5 pyramid tickets on their space. Sort the coins into a bank.
Roll the 5 racing dice and put each camel on the space shown (1, 2 or 3), stacking camels that share a space.

Roll the grey die for each crazy camel (black, white) and place it on space 16 minus the roll (grey 1 = space 16, 2 = 15, 3 = 14), facing counterclockwise. A second camel on the same space goes on top.
Drop all 6 dice into the pyramid and put it on its space.
Take the 5 finish cards and the spectator tile of one character. Keep cards hidden.
With fewer than 6 players leave the partnership cards in the box.
Also take your character's partnership card, available side up.
The youngest player gets the starting player marker.

turn.summary: Take one of four actions (five with 6 or more players). Play runs clockwise.
steps: Take the top betting ticket of any colour, backing that camel to lead at the end of the leg.
Place or move your spectator tile on an empty space that is not space 1 and not next to another tile, cheering or booing side up.
Take a pyramid ticket, shake the pyramid, reveal one die and move that camel. Put the die on a dice tent. Grey moves a crazy camel.
Put one finish card face down on the overall winner or overall loser betting space.
With 6 or more players: swap partnership cards with another player who is available, to be betting partners for the rest of the leg.

round_end: A leg ends when the last pyramid ticket is taken. Reveal and move that die first, then score the leg.
Give the starting marker to the left of whoever took the last ticket.
Return the tickets, pyramid tickets and spectator tiles, and put the revealed dice back in the pyramid. Start the next leg.
end: The game ends immediately when any camel crosses the finish line, even a crazy camel going the other way. Score a final leg, then the overall winner and loser bets.

scoring.text: Leg: each ticket on the leading camel pays its printed value (5, 3 or 2). Each ticket on the second camel pays 1. Tickets on other camels cost 1. Each pyramid ticket pays 1.

Overall winner and loser: flip each deck so the first card placed is on top. For cards showing the true winner (or loser), the first pays 8, then 5, 3, 2, and 1 each for the rest. Each card showing another camel costs 1.
With 6 or more players, each player may copy one of their partner's tickets and add its reward to their own.

missed.text: A camel higher in a stack counts as ahead of those below it. Crazy camels are ignored for ranking.
A moving camel carries every camel on top of it, but not those beneath.
A camel unit landing on a camel unit jumps on top. A booing tile sends it back 1, underneath.
The owner of a spectator tile gains 1 EP whenever a camel stops on it.
You cannot go below 0 EP. If you cannot pay, you pay nothing.
You can only play a finish card as your action; placed cards cannot be changed.

unverified: Crazy camel start spaces: the dice faces are icons, so the mapping of grey roll to space (1 to 16, 2 to 15, 3 to 14) is inferred from the order printed
The 3–8 player range is the one printed on the box; the rulebook text does not state it.
